test_title: PYST 36: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

A famous company conducted the workshop for its customers.

options.text: The workshop were conducted by a famous company for its customers.
The workshop had been conducted by a famous company for its customers.
The workshop was conducted by a famous company for its customers.
The workshop is conducted by a famous company for its customers.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "A famous company conducted the workshop for its customers."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the workshop" at the beginning.
